_help: What coins can buy. Each reward: id (short, no spaces), title, coins (the price), what (one line). Visitors ask to redeem on My Progress; the request goes to the redeem endpoint or email in config.js and you send the coupon yourself. Shop and book items with a coins field also show a coin price.
title: Your coins
line: Earn coins by playing, finishing toys and sharing. Spend them on rewards.
how: Open your first toy of the day: +5
note: Coins live in this browser only. Clearing it or switching phones starts you at zero. Each reward counts once per toy.
